spans.s: कु—यज्विन् m. a bad sacrificer, BhP. iv, 6, 50.
कु॑—यव mfn. (कु॑-) causing a bad harvest (N. of a demon slain by Indra), RV.
कु॑—यव m. N. of another demon, RV. i, 103, 8 (and 104, 3)
कु॑—यव n. a bad harvest (?) See कू॑-य्˚.
N. of particular grains, MaitrS. ii, 11, 4; Kapiṣṭh. xxviii, 9
कु—योग m. an inauspicious conjunction of planets or signs or periods, &c.
कु—योगिन् m. a bad Yogin, impostor, BhP.
कु—योनि f. a base womb, womb of a low woman, MārkP.
(कुय = 1. कु), speaking ill, abusing (N. of a demon slain by Indra), RV. i, 174, 7 (cf. RV. v, 29, 10 and 32, 8.)
